gaps.title: No A* pathfinding algorithm
gaps.description: A* is the standard heuristic search algorithm for grid-based and graph-based pathfinding. Essential for obstacle avoidance and optimal path computation in agricultural fields with obstacles (trees, rocks, buildings).
gaps.impact: Cannot plan paths around obstacles; limited to simple rectangular fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement A* with configurable heuristics (Manhattan, Euclidean, Chebyshev) for grid-based field representation

gaps.title: No RRT/RRT* algorithm
gaps.description: Rapidly-exploring Random Trees are essential for high-dimensional path planning and non-holonomic vehicle constraints (e.g., minimum turning radius for tractors).
gaps.impact: Cannot handle vehicle kinematic constraints or complex obstacle fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement RRT and RRT* with steering models for agricultural vehicles

gaps.title: No Dijkstra's algorithm
gaps.description: Dijkstra's algorithm is the baseline for shortest-path computation without heuristics. Needed as fallback when no heuristic is available.
gaps.impact: No guaranteed optimal path without A* heuristic
gaps.recommendation: Implement Dijkstra as baseline shortest-path algorithm

gaps.title: No D* (Dynamic A*) algorithm
gaps.description: D* is essential for dynamic replanning when obstacles are discovered during execution (e.g., newly detected rocks, animals, or other drones).
gaps.impact: Cannot replan paths when environment changes during execution
gaps.recommendation: Implement D* Lite for efficient incremental replanning

gaps.title: No PRM (Probabilistic Roadmap)
gaps.description: PRM is useful for pre-computing roadmaps in complex environments that can be reused for multiple queries.
gaps.impact: Repeated planning in same field is inefficient
gaps.recommendation: Implement PRM for multi-query path planning scenarios

gaps.title: No wavefront algorithm
gaps.description: Wavefront (brushfire) algorithm is simple and effective for grid-based coverage with obstacles.
gaps.impact: No alternative coverage pattern for obstacle-rich environments
gaps.recommendation: Implement wavefront propagation for obstacle-aware coverage

gaps.title: No spiral coverage pattern
gaps.description: Spiral pattern is useful for circular or irregular fields and for center-out or center-in coverage strategies.
gaps.impact: Cannot efficiently cover circular/irregular fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement spiral coverage for non-rectangular fields

gaps.title: No zigzag/diagonal coverage pattern
gaps.description: Diagonal patterns can reduce total path length for certain field shapes.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal path length for some field geometries
gaps.recommendation: Implement diagonal boustrophedon as alternative pattern

gaps.title: No obstacle avoidance
gaps.description: Current implementation assumes rectangular fields with no obstacles. Real agricultural fields have trees, rocks, power lines, buildings, and other hazards.
gaps.impact: Paths may collide with obstacles; unsafe for real-world deployment
gaps.recommendation: Add obstacle representation and integrate with A*/RRT for obstacle-aware planning

gaps.title: No non-convex field support
gaps.description: Current implementation uses bounding box which over-covers for L-shaped, T-shaped, or irregular fields, leading to wasted time and resources.
gaps.impact: Wasted coverage area and resources on non-convex fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement polygon clipping and decomposition for non-convex fields

gaps.title: No multi-field support
gaps.description: Agricultural operations often span multiple adjacent or separate fields. Current implementation handles one field at a time.
gaps.impact: Cannot optimize routes across multiple fields
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-field planning with inter-field transit optimization

gaps.title: No terrain/elevation consideration
gaps.description: Agricultural fields have slopes and elevation changes that affect vehicle speed, energy consumption, and safety.
gaps.impact: Inaccurate time/energy estimates; potential safety issues on steep slopes
gaps.recommendation: Add DEM (Digital Elevation Model) integration for terrain-aware planning

gaps.title: No energy/battery constraints
gaps.description: Drones and electric vehicles have limited battery life. Current implementation doesn't consider energy consumption or range limits.
gaps.impact: Planned paths may exceed vehicle range; no recharge stop planning
gaps.recommendation: Add energy model and recharge/refuel stop insertion

gaps.title: No wind/weather consideration
gaps.description: Wind affects drone flight time, spray drift, and energy consumption. Current implementation ignores weather.
gaps.impact: Inaccurate time estimates; unsafe operations in high wind
gaps.recommendation: Add weather data integration for wind-aware planning

gaps.title: No dynamic replanning
gaps.description: When obstacles are discovered or conditions change during execution, the path cannot be updated.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to changing conditions during execution
gaps.recommendation: Implement D* Lite or similar incremental replanning

gaps.title: No path smoothing
gaps.description: Boustrophedon paths have sharp 180-degree turns at field edges. Smoothing reduces wear and energy consumption.
gaps.impact: Increased vehicle wear and energy consumption
gaps.recommendation: Add path smoothing with curvature constraints (e.g., Dubins paths)

gaps.title: No partial coverage support
gaps.description: Sometimes only a portion of the field needs coverage (e.g., pest hotspots, nutrient-deficient zones).
gaps.impact: Cannot perform targeted/precision coverage
gaps.recommendation: Add support for partial field coverage with priority zones

gaps.title: No no-fly zone support
gaps.description: Regulatory no-fly zones (airports, military bases, populated areas) must be avoided.
gaps.impact: Potential regulatory violations
gaps.recommendation: Add geofencing with no-fly zone polygons

gaps.title: No headland turn optimization
gaps.description: Headland turns at field edges are time-consuming. Different turn patterns (loop, skip, U-turn) have different efficiencies.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal turn patterns waste time
gaps.recommendation: Add headland turn pattern selection and optimization

gaps.title: No variable rate application support
gaps.description: Precision agriculture requires varying application rates based on soil/pest maps. Current implementation assumes uniform coverage.
gaps.impact: Cannot support variable rate application
gaps.recommendation: Add VRA (Variable Rate Application) map integration

gaps.title: No multi-drone coverage coordination
gaps.description: Multiple drones covering the same field need coordinated paths to avoid collisions and ensure complete coverage.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale to multi-drone operations
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-agent coverage with collision avoidance and task decomposition

gaps.title: No path execution monitoring
gaps.description: No mechanism to detect if the vehicle deviates from the planned path or if execution fails.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect or recover from path execution failures
gaps.recommendation: Add path tracking with deviation detection and recovery

gaps.title: No large field decomposition
gaps.description: Very large fields may need to be decomposed into sub-fields for memory and computation efficiency.
gaps.impact: Performance degradation on very large fields
gaps.recommendation: Add field decomposition with hierarchical planning

gaps.title: No GPS waypoint export
gaps.description: Paths need to be exported in standard formats (GPX, GeoJSON, KML) for drone flight controllers.
gaps.impact: Cannot directly use paths with commercial drone systems
gaps.recommendation: Add export to GPX, GeoJSON, and KML formats

gaps.title: No 3D terrain following
gaps.description: Drones may need to follow terrain at constant altitude above ground level.
gaps.impact: Cannot maintain constant AGL altitude over varying terrain
gaps.recommendation: Add terrain-following altitude profile generation

gaps.title: No task reassignment on agent failure
gaps.description: When an agent is marked as FAILED, its assigned tasks remain in ASSIGNED state forever. No mechanism to reassign those tasks to other agents.
gaps.impact: Tasks assigned to failed agents are lost; swarm cannot recover from agent failures
gaps.recommendation: Add task reassignment logic that detects failed agents and reassigns their tasks to active agents

gaps.title: No leader election
gaps.description: No mechanism to elect a leader agent for coordination decisions. All agents are peers with no hierarchy.
gaps.impact: No single point of coordination; potential for conflicting decisions
gaps.recommendation: Implement leader election (e.g., Bully algorithm, Raft-based election)

gaps.title: No collision avoidance
gaps.description: No mechanism to prevent multiple agents from occupying the same space or colliding.
gaps.impact: Physical collisions between agents possible
gaps.recommendation: Add collision avoidance with spatial separation constraints

gaps.title: No formation flying
gaps.description: No support for agents maintaining specific geometric formations during movement.
gaps.impact: Cannot execute formation-based operations (e.g., coordinated spraying)
gaps.recommendation: Add formation control with configurable patterns

gaps.title: No task preemption
gaps.description: No mechanism to preempt lower-priority tasks when higher-priority tasks arrive.
gaps.impact: Cannot respond to urgent tasks promptly
gaps.recommendation: Add priority-based task preemption

gaps.title: No priority-based task scheduling
gaps.description: Tasks have no priority field. All tasks are treated equally regardless of urgency.
gaps.impact: Cannot prioritize critical tasks (e.g., pest outbreak response)
gaps.recommendation: Add task priority field and priority-aware scheduling

gaps.title: No deadline-aware scheduling
gaps.description: Tasks have no deadlines. Cannot ensure time-critical tasks complete on time.
gaps.impact: Cannot guarantee task completion within time constraints
gaps.recommendation: Add task deadlines and deadline-aware scheduling

gaps.title: No resource constraints
gaps.description: Agents have no resource limits (battery, payload, fuel). Tasks have no resource requirements.
gaps.impact: Can over-assign tasks beyond agent capacity
gaps.recommendation: Add resource model with capacity constraints

gaps.title: No communication constraints
gaps.description: No model of communication range or bandwidth limitations between agents.
gaps.impact: Cannot plan for communication-limited environments
gaps.recommendation: Add communication range model and constraint-aware task assignment

gaps.title: No task dependencies
gaps.description: Tasks cannot depend on other tasks. Cannot model workflows where task B requires task A to complete first.
gaps.impact: Cannot model complex multi-step operations
gaps.recommendation: Add task dependency graph with topological ordering

gaps.title: No task decomposition
gaps.description: No mechanism to decompose complex tasks into subtasks.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle complex multi-step tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add task decomposition with subtask management

gaps.title: No agent recovery mechanism
gaps.description: Failed agents are permanently marked as FAILED. No mechanism to recover or restart agents.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from transient failures
gaps.recommendation: Add agent recovery with state reset and task reassignment

gaps.title: No task retry mechanism
gaps.description: Failed tasks cannot be retried. No retry count or backoff strategy.
gaps.impact: Transient task failures are permanent
gaps.recommendation: Add task retry with configurable max retries and exponential backoff

gaps.title: No distributed coordination
gaps.description: All coordination is centralized in a single SwarmCoordinator instance. No support for distributed coordination across multiple coordinators.
gaps.impact: Single point of failure; cannot scale to large swarms
gaps.recommendation: Add distributed coordination with coordinator replication

gaps.title: No agent capacity limits
gaps.description: No limit on how many tasks can be assigned to a single agent. The load balancing only considers current assignment count.
gaps.impact: Can overload agents with too many tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add max tasks per agent limit

gaps.title: No consensus integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with ByzantineConsensus for coordinated decision-making.
gaps.impact: Cannot make Byzantine-fault-tolerant collective decisions
gaps.recommendation: Integrate consensus module for collective decision-making

gaps.title: No task allocation integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with TaskAllocator for optimal task assignment.
gaps.impact: Uses simple greedy matching instead of optimal allocation
gaps.recommendation: Integrate TaskAllocator for optimal task-to-agent assignment

gaps.title: No path planning integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with CoveragePlanner for path planning.
gaps.impact: Cannot plan paths for agents to reach task locations
gaps.recommendation: Integrate path planning for agent routing

gaps.title: No heartbeat authentication
gaps.description: Heartbeats are not authenticated. Any process can send heartbeats for any agent.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerability; potential for spoofed heartbeats
gaps.recommendation: Add heartbeat authentication with agent credentials

gaps.title: No metrics collection
gaps.description: No metrics on task completion time, agent utilization, swarm throughput, etc.
gaps.impact: Cannot monitor or optimize swarm performance
gaps.recommendation: Add metrics collection and reporting

gaps.title: No actual PBFT implementation
gaps.description: The consensus module is a simulation, not a real PBFT implementation. The propose() method only returns PENDING for multi-node systems without any actual message exchange.
gaps.impact: Cannot be used for real distributed consensus; only useful for testing
gaps.recommendation: Implement full PBFT with pre-prepare, prepare, and commit phases

gaps.title: No message passing layer
gaps.description: No network layer for sending and receiving consensus messages between nodes.
gaps.impact: Cannot communicate with other nodes in a real deployment
gaps.recommendation: Add network layer with message serialization and transport

gaps.title: No view change protocol
gaps.description: PBFT requires a view change protocol to handle primary node failure. Not implemented.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from primary node failure
gaps.recommendation: Implement view change protocol for primary failure recovery

gaps.title: No checkpointing
gaps.description: No checkpointing mechanism for log compaction and state transfer.
gaps.impact: Log grows unboundedly; new nodes cannot catch up efficiently
gaps.recommendation: Add checkpointing with state transfer for new nodes

gaps.title: No log replication
gaps.description: No replicated log for consensus decisions. Only single-value voting is supported.
gaps.impact: Cannot maintain consistent state across nodes
gaps.recommendation: Add replicated log with log entry sequencing

gaps.title: No leader election
gaps.description: No mechanism to elect or change the primary/leader node.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle leader failure or dynamic membership
gaps.recommendation: Implement leader election integrated with view change

gaps.title: No client request handling
gaps.description: No mechanism for clients to submit requests to the consensus system.
gaps.impact: Cannot accept external requests for consensus
gaps.recommendation: Add client request API with request queuing

gaps.title: No state machine replication
gaps.description: No replicated state machine for executing consensus decisions.
gaps.impact: Cannot maintain consistent application state across nodes
gaps.recommendation: Add state machine replication layer

gaps.title: No cryptographic signatures
gaps.description: No message authentication or integrity verification. Votes and proposals are not signed.
gaps.impact: Vulnerable to message tampering and spoofing
gaps.recommendation: Add cryptographic signatures for all consensus messages

gaps.title: No timeout handling
gaps.description: No timeout for consensus rounds. If nodes don't respond, consensus hangs indefinitely.
gaps.impact: Consensus can stall indefinitely
gaps.recommendation: Add consensus timeouts with automatic retry or view change

gaps.title: No recovery mechanism
gaps.description: No mechanism for nodes to recover and rejoin the consensus after failure.
gaps.impact: Failed nodes cannot rejoin; system degrades over time
gaps.recommendation: Add node recovery with state catch-up

gaps.title: No dynamic membership
gaps.description: Total node count is fixed at initialization. Cannot add or remove nodes at runtime.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale swarm membership dynamically
gaps.recommendation: Add dynamic membership with reconfiguration protocol

gaps.title: No vote deduplication
gaps.description: tally_votes() counts duplicate votes from the same node. No deduplication by node ID.
gaps.impact: A single node can vote multiple times to reach quorum
gaps.recommendation: Add vote deduplication by node ID

gaps.title: No tie-breaking
gaps.description: When two values have the same vote count, max() picks arbitrarily. No deterministic tie-breaking.
gaps.impact: Non-deterministic consensus results
gaps.recommendation: Add deterministic tie-breaking (e.g., lexicographic order)

gaps.title: No auction-based allocation
gaps.description: Auction-based algorithms (e.g., Vickrey auction) are effective for distributed task allocation with self-interested agents.
gaps.impact: Cannot use market-based allocation strategies
gaps.recommendation: Implement auction-based task allocation

gaps.title: No contract net protocol
gaps.description: Contract Net Protocol (CNP) is a standard multi-agent task allocation protocol where agents bid on tasks.
gaps.impact: Cannot use CNP for distributed task allocation
gaps.recommendation: Implement Contract Net Protocol with bidding and awarding

gaps.title: No Hungarian for rectangular matrices
gaps.description: Hungarian algorithm falls back to greedy for non-square matrices. Rectangular assignment is common (more tasks than agents or vice versa).
gaps.impact: Suboptimal allocation for rectangular cost matrices
gaps.recommendation: Implement rectangular Hungarian algorithm

gaps.title: No market-based allocation
gaps.description: Market-based mechanisms (e.g., task markets with pricing) can achieve efficient allocation.
gaps.impact: Cannot use market-based allocation strategies
gaps.recommendation: Add market-based task allocation with pricing

gaps.title: No task dependencies
gaps.description: Tasks cannot depend on other tasks. Cannot model precedence constraints.
gaps.impact: Cannot model workflows with ordering constraints
gaps.recommendation: Add task dependency graph with topological ordering

gaps.title: No task priorities
gaps.description: Tasks have no priority. All tasks are treated equally.
gaps.impact: Cannot prioritize critical tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add task priority field and priority-aware allocation

gaps.title: No task deadlines
gaps.description: Tasks have no deadlines. Cannot ensure time-critical tasks are assigned to agents that can complete them in time.
gaps.impact: Cannot guarantee task completion within time constraints
gaps.recommendation: Add task deadlines and deadline-aware allocation

gaps.title: No resource constraints
gaps.description: Agents have no resource limits (battery, payload, fuel). Tasks have no resource requirements.
gaps.impact: Can over-assign tasks beyond agent capacity
gaps.recommendation: Add resource model with capacity constraints

gaps.title: No time windows
gaps.description: Tasks cannot have time windows (earliest start, latest completion).
gaps.impact: Cannot model time-constrained operations
gaps.recommendation: Add time window constraints to tasks

gaps.title: No multi-objective optimization
gaps.description: Only minimizes total cost. Cannot optimize for multiple objectives (cost, time, energy, fairness).
gaps.impact: Cannot balance competing objectives
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-objective optimization (e.g., weighted sum, Pareto frontier)

gaps.title: No dynamic allocation
gaps.description: Allocation is static. Cannot reallocate when new tasks arrive or agents fail.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to changing conditions
gaps.recommendation: Add dynamic reallocation with incremental updates

gaps.title: No online allocation
gaps.description: No support for online allocation where tasks arrive over time.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle streaming task arrivals
gaps.recommendation: Add online allocation with competitive ratio guarantees

gaps.title: No fault tolerance
gaps.description: No mechanism to handle agent failures during allocation. If an agent fails after allocation, tasks are lost.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from agent failures during execution
gaps.recommendation: Add fault-tolerant allocation with task reassignment

gaps.title: No scalability limits
gaps.description: Hungarian algorithm is O(n^3). No approximation algorithms for large-scale problems.
gaps.impact: Performance degradation for large numbers of agents/tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add approximation algorithms for large-scale allocation

gaps.title: No unassigned task reporting
gaps.description: AllocationResult has unassigned_tasks field but it's never populated. Greedy always assigns all tasks.
gaps.impact: Cannot identify tasks that couldn't be assigned
gaps.recommendation: Populate unassigned_tasks when no suitable agent exists

gaps.title: No cost matrix validation
gaps.description: No validation for negative costs, NaN, or infinite values in cost matrix.
gaps.impact: Invalid cost values can produce incorrect allocations
gaps.recommendation: Add cost matrix validation for negative, NaN, and infinite values

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No integration between modules
cross_cutting_gaps.description: The four modules (coverage, swarm, consensus, task_allocation) are completely independent. No module imports or uses any other module.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot build a complete multi-agent agricultural planning system
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Create a top-level orchestrator that integrates all modules

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No common data model
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Each module has its own data classes with no shared abstractions. No common representation of agents, tasks, fields, or paths.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot pass data between modules without adaptation
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Create shared data model with common types

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No configuration management
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No centralized configuration for module parameters. Each module has hardcoded defaults.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot configure modules for different scenarios
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add centralized configuration with per-module settings

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No logging standardization
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Each module uses its own logging format. No correlation IDs or request tracing across modules.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add standardized logging with correlation IDs

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No error handling strategy
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Each module has its own error handling. No common error types or recovery strategies.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add common error types and recovery strategies

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No testing integration
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Tests are per-module with no integration tests. No end-to-end test of the full pipeline.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add integration tests for the full planning pipeline

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No API/interface definition
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No public API or interface definition for the modules. Each module is used directly.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot swap implementations or add new algorithms easily
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Define abstract interfaces for each module

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No documentation
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No documentation on how to use the modules together or how they relate to each other.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Difficult for developers to understand the system
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add architecture documentation with module interaction diagrams

PP-002: Implement RRT/RRT* for vehicle kinematic constraints
PP-009: Add obstacle avoidance to coverage planner
SW-001: Add task reassignment on agent failure
